question: What is the name of the Governor of West Bengal who administered the oath to CM Mamata Banerjee as MLA in 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shri Jagdeep Dhankhar.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Since August 11, 2022, **Jagdeep Dhankhar,** an** Indian lawyer and politician **who was born on May 18, 1951, has been acting as India's vice president, replacing **Venkaiah Naidu.** He previously held the **job of Governor of West Bengal **before taking this one.
